simple.meaning: בְּרָכָה (Bᵉrâkâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “benediction ; by implication prosperity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 69 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 12:2. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּרָכָה (H1293).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בְּרָכָה (Bᵉrâkâh) / H1293 is traced through Genesis 12:2, Genesis 27:12, Genesis 27:35, Genesis 27:36 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H1293. berakah I. בְּרָכָה noun feminine blessing (Arabic ; Ethiopic Aramaic בִּרְכָּא ; Late Hebrew as Hebrew) — ׳ב Gen 12:2 39t.; construct בִּרְכַּת 28:4 9 t.; suffix בִּרְכָתוֺ 49:28 7 t.; plural בְּרָכוֺת Psa 21:7 4 t.; construct בִּרְכֹת בִּרְכוֺת, Gen 49:25 5 t.; suffix בִּרְכוֺתֵיכֶם Mal 2:2 ; — 1 blessing: a. of parent Gen 27:12 , 41 ; 49:28 (JE), of Moses Deut 33:1 . b. of God Exod 32:29 (E) Lev 25:21 (P) Deut 11:26-27 , 29 ; 23:6 (= Neh 13:2 ) Deut 28:2 ; 28:8 ; 30:1 ; 30:19 ; Josh 8:34 (D) 2Sam 7:29 ; Psalm 3:9; Psa 21:4 ; 133:3 ; Isa 44:3 ; Ezek 34:26 ; 44:30 ; Joel 2:14 ; Mal 3:10 ; יהוה ברכת Gen 39:5 (J) Deut 12:15 ; 16:17 ; 33:23 ; Psa 129:8 ; Prov 10:22 ; י מאת ׳ברכה Psa 24:5 ; אברהם ברכת Gen 28:4 (P), the blessing given to Abraham. c. of the people , in recognition of good men Psa 109:17 ; Prov 10:6 ; 11:26 ; 24:25 ; 28:20 . d. of a poor man , in recognition of benefits Job 29:13 . 2 source of blessing: Abraham Gen 12:2 (J); Israel Isa 19:24 ; Ezek 34:26 ; Zech 8:13 ; seed of the righteous Psa 37:26 ; the king 21:7 ; memory of the righteous Prov 10:7 ; new wine Isa 65:8 . 3 blessing, prosperity: ישׁרים בברכת by the prosperity of the upright (the city is exalted) Prov 11:11 ; מורה יעטה ברכות גם yea, the early rain covereth with blessings Psa 84:7 compare Gen 49:25-26 , ברכותיכם את וארותי and I will curse your prosperity Mal 2:2 . 4 blessing, praise of God Neh 9:5 . 5 a gift, present Gen 33:11 (E) Josh 15:19 (J) Judg 1:15 ; 1Sam 25:27 ; 30:26 ; 2Kin 5:15 ; בְּרָכָה נֶפֶשׁ a liberal person Prov 11:25 (compare Syriac , Ethiopic ). 6 treaty of peace 2Kin 18:31 = Isa 36:16 .
